justification: The AI reader skipped pages inside batches that returned something, so nothing noticed: the Warringah re-read left out 21 of 226 pages and would have deleted 172 printed rules; Canterbury-Bankstown chapters are live without pages of rules. The reader now counts left-out pages by code and re-reads them, refusing the chapter if a page of rules is still missing. Critical: this is what stops printed rules silently disappearing.

pre_impl.existing_data: No database writes. Measured with PyMuPDF sentence lines against extracted text: Warringah re-read 21 of 226 pages left out; Canterbury-Bankstown 6-2 (live) 33 of 195 pages flagged; Campbelltown part 3 (read well) 2 of 72; Woollahra B1 0 of 27.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: Assumed the chunk-loss guard covered skipped pages. It only fires when a whole batch returns nothing; the model skipped pages inside batches that returned rules.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: _rule_bearing_pages only asks whether a page could hold a rule. page_coverage compares each page's own lines with what the reader returned; nothing did that before.
pre_impl.external_source_error: If PyMuPDF cannot open the PDF the reader raises before returning, so a chapter is never accepted unchecked.
pre_impl.frontend_type: No frontend change: this runs inside the extraction pipeline before anything is queued for review.
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: A page of rules the model keeps skipping after its re-read now refuses the chapter by name. Pages without rule words (history, definitions, amendment tables) are reported and allowed.

falsifiable_check.fails_when: a page of rules left out by the reader is not re-read, or is still missing and the chapter is not refused
falsifiable_check.observed_red: Live trial on the Warringah DCP, no DB writes: 21 pages left out, 17 recovered by the re-read (108 rules), 4 left with 0-1 rule words each. 11 mutations of the new logic all caught.

functions.name: page_coverage.skipped_pages
functions.input: Every page's text lines from PyMuPDF, and every text the reader returned for the document.
functions.output: Page numbers with five or more sentence lines of which fewer than 30% appear in the output.
functions.if_none: An empty output marks every judged page as left out; pages under five sentence lines are not judged.

functions.name: page_coverage.sentence_lines
functions.input: The text lines of one page, as PyMuPDF returns them, possibly drawn twice.
functions.output: Lines of six or more words, identical lines once, letter-spaced map labels dropped.
functions.if_none: No qualifying lines returns an empty list, and the page is then not judged.

functions.name: ai_extractor._reread_skipped_pages
functions.input: The chapter PDF path, its pypdf reader, the model name and the provisions collected so far.
functions.output: Adds provisions from re-reading left-out pages; raises PageLoss if a page with rule words is still missing.
functions.if_none: No left-out pages means no model call at all, and the provisions are returned unchanged.

values.name: page left out
values.why: Warringah skipped pages sat near 0%; Campbelltown pages read well sat far above.

values.name: rule words to refuse
values.why: The 4 pages the model rightly skipped held 0, 0, 1, 0; recovered rule pages up to 6.

break_it.scenario: The model returns rules for a batch but skips a page inside it
break_it.what_happens: Before this change the page's rules were lost and nothing reported it.
break_it.how: The page is counted as left out and read again on its own.

break_it.scenario: A page of rules is still skipped after its re-read
break_it.what_happens: Approving the chapter would delete the rules printed on that page from what we serve.
break_it.how: PageLoss refuses the chapter, naming the pages.

break_it.scenario: The council's PDF draws every line twice, one copy on top of the other (Campbelltown)
break_it.what_happens: Every page looked half-read and would be re-read or refused wrongly.
break_it.how: Identical lines on a page count once.

break_it.scenario: A map page of letter-spaced street labels (Canterbury-Bankstown)
break_it.what_happens: Street labels looked like unread sentences, so map pages would be flagged as left out.
break_it.how: A line mostly of single letters is not a sentence.

break_it.scenario: Suburb history, definitions or an amendment table the model rightly passes over
break_it.what_happens: A strict check would refuse good chapters because of pages that hold no rules.
break_it.how: Only a still-missing page with two or more rule words refuses.

post_merge.manual_verify: Re-read the chapters dq_probe_pages_left_out.py lists (Canterbury-Bankstown 6-2, 7-5, 11-11 first) and Warringah with the merged reader.
